Import an older exported CSV (up to 2 MB). Only aggregate history is restored, not asset bindings or calibration baselines. Duplicates are skipped.
Import failed. Choose a complete CinemaWatch CSV export no larger than 2 MB.
Imported aggregate history; excluded from calibration
Inspection ended; unregistered signals were cleared. Assets can still be created manually.

Wi-Fi receives AP / hotspot broadcasts; BLE receives nearby advertisements. Valid RSSI and fresh scans are accepted and radio addresses are deduplicated within a session. Names, vendors and signature clues support tentative groups, not verified models or ownership. Authorized assets have independent IDs. Unregistered identifiers are cleared at the end; only category counts and sampling quality persist. At least 3 healthy inspections establish an RSSI baseline; 2 consecutive healthy inspections without a sighting flag absence. No people estimates before calibration.
Integrity, package, version and signing certificate verified
GitHub is contacted only when you check or download. Cinema, asset and inspection data are never uploaded.
